questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答}\;\;y=(1-x)^{n}(1+x)^{n},\;\; \text{记}\;\;u=(1+x)^{n},\;\;v=(1-x)^{n},\\&u^{\prime}=n(1+x)^{n-1},\;\;u^{\prime \prime}=n(n-1)(1+x)^{n-2},\;\;\cdots,\\&u^{(n-1)}=n\cdot(n-1)\cdots 2\cdot(1+x),\;\;u^{(n)}=n!\\&v^{\prime}=-n(1-x)^{n-1},\;\;v^{\prime \prime}=n(n-1)(1-x)^{n-2},\;\;\cdots\\&v^{(n-1)}=(-1)^{n-1}n\cdot(n-1)\cdots 2\cdot(1-x),\;\;v^{(n)}=(-1)^{n}n!,\\&\text{利用莱布尼茨公式，有}\\&y^{(n)}=u^{(n)}v+C_{n}^{1}n^{(n-1)}v^{\prime}+\cdots+uv^{(n)}\\&\qquad=n!(1-x)^{n}+nn!(x+1)\cdot(-1)n(1-x)^{n-1}+\cdots+(1+x)^{n}(-1)^{n}n!,\\&\qquad=n!(1-x)^{n}-n^{2}n!(x+1)(1-x)^{n-1}+\cdots+(1+x)^{n}(-1)^{n}n!,\\&\qquad=n!(1-x)^{n}\left[1-n^{2}\frac{1+x}{1-x}+\cdots+(-1)^{n}\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right)^{n}\right].\end{aligned}
